description:
src/session.rs:437-472. The new chat_capability_preserves_vendor_extras and chat_push_capability_preserves_vendor_extras tests only verify the deserialize half. AGENTS.md 'Extras-preservation policy' test discipline says 'For structs, the test asserts an unknown field survives serialize.' But these types are Deserialize-only (no Serialize derive at lines 22, 80) so the serialize half is uncheckable. Inconsistency: the extra field's #[serde(...skip_serializing_if = "...")] attribute (lines 67, 98) and the 'deserialize/serialize round-trip' rustdoc claim (lines 55, 95) are dead text — there's no Serialize to skip in.

Two cleanups, pick one:
(a) Document explicitly that these types are deserialize-only at the wire boundary (client only reads capability from server, never sends). Drop the skip_serializing_if attribute and rewrite the round-trip rustdoc.
(b) Add Serialize to the derives and extend each test to round-trip back through to_value/from_value.

Additionally: no test verifies that a typed field like supportedBodyTypes does NOT get duplicated into extra. Add: `{supportedBodyTypes:[...],acmeFlag:"x"}` should produce typed field populated AND extra containing only acmeFlag.
title: Extras-policy tests cover only deserialize half; Capability types lack Serialize
